long_biography.plain_text:
DeFrancesco discovered yoga after years of intensive exercise, as family and career demands made her existing routine harder to sustain. The gentler movement and emotional discipline changed her daily life, prompting her to complete a teaching certification. She named her planned studio SOL, short for Secret of Life, and developed the concept around the ease and connection she found in the practice.

The first SOL Yoga opened in Miami in 2018, combining infrared-heated classes with wellness amenities and communal spaces. DeFrancesco later established studios in Fort Lauderdale and Miami Beach. The programme ranges from flow and sculpt sessions to Pilates and restorative practice, while the physical spaces reflect her aim of making regular movement and self-care welcoming rather than intimidating.
